Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't deleted yet. Once all of the processing for this card's [Your Turn] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: I activated "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn" in this card's [Your Turn] effect, and the DP of my opponent's Digimon became 0. At such times, is that Digimon deleted before the part of the effect after "then"?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.

[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon get linked, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may app fuse into a Digimon card in the hand.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
